description: This file defines the HtmlRenderer class, a core component responsible for rendering main content as HTML responses in Drupal. It manages page assembly, theming, cacheability, and hook invocations for page attachments and page top/bottom regions.

classes.name: HtmlRenderer
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering main content as HTML responses, managing page assembly, theming, caching, and hook invocations within Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes dependencies such as title resolver, display variant manager, event dispatcher, module handler, renderer, render cache, renderer config, and theme manager.

methods.name: renderResponse
methods.description: Generates an HTML response from the main content array, wrapping it in a full HTML page, managing cacheability, and attaching necessary assets.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the main content for rendering by wrapping it in a page structure, selecting display variants, and applying theming.

methods.name: invokePageAttachmentHooks
methods.description: Invokes hooks for adding or altering page attachments, merging them into the page render array.

methods.name: buildPageTopAndBottom
methods.description: Invokes hooks to add content to the top and bottom regions of the page.
